picture: a crescent moon in the night sky
hint: A crescent moon — Ramadan begins when it is seen.

picture: the sun rising over the sea
hint: Suhoor is eaten before dawn, before the sun comes up.

picture: the sun setting behind a palm tree
hint: Iftar is the meal at sunset.
Many people raise their hands when they make a dua.

picture: a building with a dome and a tall tower
hint: A mosque is a place where Muslims pray together.

picture: an open book on a stand
hint: The Quran is the holy book of Islam.

picture: a giving box with a heart
hint: Charity means giving to help others.

picture: bunting, a moon and a star
hint: Eid is the happy celebration at the end of Ramadan.
Many people begin Iftar with dates and water.
Lanterns light up homes and streets in Ramadan.
